correctness.rationale: A bijection with q−1 nested threshold crisp preorders yields F(q)=sum a_k C(q−1,k). There are 4096 binary off-diagonal masks for four labelled worlds and transitivity is exhaustively checked on all 64 triples. The checker enumerates exactly 355 preorders, executes an exhaustive strict-inclusion recurrence, and certifies all ten printed coefficients. Degree at most nine follows from the explicit increasing preorder rank c(P)+4−e(P). Ten exact polynomial comparisons and an independent q=3 nested-pair count verify closed-form algebra. Uniform probability divides by precisely q^12 assignments; leading polynomial coefficient is 16/189. Infinite sizes are not claimed.

value.rationale: Four worlds are the first small model that permits two disjoint pairs and interacting equivalence-class merges, making the 355-state multichain census nontrivial. The polynomial gives an exact q-dependent quality-control baseline for random fuzzy accessibility matrices, including counts for every q and a sharp probability constant 16/189 in the rare-event large-alphabet regime. The precise finite natural invariant is motivated by the 2025 random fuzzy-matrix closure study and can benchmark its closure routines; no unproved downstream theorem is asserted.
